Full summary: D51/DP-0: working-set renderRecord now renders observation substance (source_kind [uri] via check_method · at observed_at · volatile · base..head, head = result.summary or sorted scalar key=value ≤240) and 'revision base..head' (8-hex) on every scope line; 10 tests added (red on old renderer); repo_id/repo_ids mismatch assessed, not fixed.
Decisions: Chose to render an observation's result as sorted top-level scalar key=value pairs (bounded to 240 chars, whitespace collapsed, nested values skipped) when result.summary is absent, over JSON.stringify or insertion-order rendering — sorted keys keep payload_hash replay-stable across replicas, scalars-only keeps one line per fact, and the bound stops one verbose check from eating the 6000-char budget; Chose to export renderRecord for unit tests rather than mint rulings through the ceremony — a human_ruling cannot be produced by runtime.append, and the budget loop is still exercised end-to-end through buildWorkingSet and handleClaudeCodeHook in the same test file, so the export adds no production caller; Chose to always render 'volatile: yes|no' (not only when true) so absent and false stay distinguishable, and to render the observation body's base/head on the observed line while scope.revision renders on the scope line, both as 8-hex base..head with one side allowed absent (..head, base..); Chose NOT to fix store-identity.ts reading repo_id while ensureStoreDescriptor writes repo_ids — the fix is two lines (fall back to repo_ids[0]) but it would change the frozen trial arm's MCP-path repo id from derived to minted and flip the RetrievalAnnex repo_identity_source/format for every identity-init store, a behaviour change outside D51's remit; recorded as a finding with the fix candidate
Findings: warning: src/retrieval/store-identity.ts readStoreIdentity requires store.json `repo_id` but ensureStoreDescriptor (identity init, adapter test fixtures, the trial seeder) writes only `repo_ids`; only migrate (v3-forward finalize) writes both. On an identity-init v3 store the ContextAssembler gates with a path-derived synthetic repo (format 2, derived: true, source 'derived-from-path'), not the minted repo_ids[0] that runtime.ts/repoIdFor stamps on every v3 event. 2.x-path retrieval still works (envelope and rows share the synthetic id by construction) but the RetrievalAnnex misreports repo_identity_source/format, and any future 2.x-row vs v3 scope.repo comparison will mismatch. v3-forward resolveIdentity/migrateStatus also read only repo_id, so `migrate` run AFTER `identity init` would mint a new seeded store_id/repo_id and overwrite store.json, orphaning ids already cited by events and memberships. Fix candidate: readStoreIdentity falls back to repo_ids[0] (+ unit test); deliberately not done under D51.; finding: the hooks' own session_start/compaction observations now render ~3x longer (kind=session_start host=… session=… start_source=… cwd=…) and still sort at class rank 2 ahead of every proposal, so on a long-lived store they take a larger share of the 6000-char budget; ordering was out of scope for D51 — a follow-up could de-prioritise host-lifecycle observations or fold them into one line.; finding: DEFAULT_WORKING_SET_BUDGET (6000) is still not wired from src/cli/hook-verb.ts (no budget option passed) — unchanged, already noted in the trial design §5.; finding: test/adapters/working-set-render.test.ts verified red on the old renderer (8/10 fail; the 2 passes are the no-change guards: empty-result id fallback and no-revision decision byte-identical) by checking out 9b0afafd's working-set.ts with only `export` added; green after: 10/10, plus review-fixes, claude-code, oracles-lane03, codex, library, gap1, gap2 all pass and tsc --noEmit is clean.
